def main():
    s = input().strip()
    insertions = 0
    run_length = 0
    prev = ''
    first = True
    for c in s:
        if first:
            prev = c
            run_length = 1
            first = False
        else:
            if c == prev:
                run_length += 1
            else:
                if run_length % 2 == 0:
                    insertions += 1
                prev = c
                run_length = 1
    if not first and run_length % 2 == 0:
        insertions += 1
    print(insertions)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
